name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build. Stable raid runtime, native wild-controller combat and the authoritative 6000-unit arena remain enabled. The visual boundary is a safer 32-character crowd ring using only the proven UPalNPCManager::SpawnNPCForServer path: 16 generic vanilla villagers and 16 proven GrassMammoths alternate at radius 6750, outside the gameplay lock. Characters are continuously forced invulnerable, non-colliding, movement-disabled and AI-suppressed; Pals are marked uncapturable through UPalIndividualCharacterParameter::SetUncapturable. No direct cosmetic or network multicast calls are used. Crowd motion is a small K2_TeleportTo sway/bounce. No client installation required.
